code.copyError: Couldn't copy — please copy the code by hand.
code.give: Give this code to your child to sign in to the Gharsah kids app.
code.label: Link code
code.privacy: Your child doesn't create an account or type an email or password — the code alone links their app to your account. You'll always find it on the child's card in the «My children» tab.
code.confirmDesc: The current code will stop working right away.
code.confirmWarn: The device linked now will be unlinked, and your child will need to enter the new code to continue their lessons.

addChild.pickReview: Choose at least one review day from the lesson days.
addChild.create: Save and create the link code
addChild.title: Add a child
addChild.editSubtitle: Change the lesson days, time and length.
addChild.newSubtitle: Three steps: their details, their schedule, then their avatar — and you'll get the link code.
addChild.privacyNote: We don't ask the child for any information — the name and age are for you only, and the teacher uses the name to call them.
addChild.ageLater: You can change the age later from the dashboard.
addChild.scheduleIntro: Set the lesson days and time — and we'll remind your child automatically.
addChild.goldNote: The gold days are the weekly review days — change them on the schedule screen.
addChild.capNote: The lesson ends when your child finishes today's lessons, never longer than this.
addChild.remind: We'll remind your child before the lesson
addChild.scheduleLater: You can change the schedule anytime from the dashboard.
addChild.avatarIntro: Modest, friendly characters — your child sees theirs in the app with every achievement.
addChild.avatarTree: The character's tree grows every time your child memorizes something new.
addChild.reviewLimit: You can choose up to 3 review days
addChild.reviewBody: On review days, a review lesson takes the place of the new lesson — your child goes over the surahs and hadiths they've memorized.
addChild.namePlaceholder: The name they like to be called
addChild.nameError: Enter the child's name (40 characters at most).
addChild.askNote: The teacher answers from approved sources only, and refers sensitive questions to you
addChild.customTitle: Set a time for each day
addChild.customOptional: Optional — for different times on different days
addChild.customNote: The default time above is used for any day you don't change.
